tests.focusedScope: Six wildlife tests and one 1mm core-grid integration test.
tests.scope: Full suite started after final wildlife geometry/material/core schema changes. During the run one remaining legacy template pitch guard was aligned from 5mm to 1mm; the final template/core path and expanded 1mm test were additionally rerun after this change.

reviewed: All twelve final front and material images through contact sheets; final bee and fish-rig material views inspected individually.
All twelve final MCP underside images through a contact sheet.
Six actual parameter-rebuild views: folded butterfly, quadruped stride, raised bird wing, fish tail bend, flexed insect and cat collar.
All twenty saved wearable-scene views through a contact sheet, and each of five material views inspected individually.
findings: Heron, stream fish, butterfly and bee have distinct silhouettes with continuous curved neck, fins and thin polygonal wings; smallest native details remain visible where scale permits.
Bee final overall length is roughly four centimetres. Continuous alternating abdominal bands replace the first jagged patch treatment; historical image and native file retained.
Skeletons are visibly tooling guides with separate rods, joint markers and sockets. Their displayed finite poses change joint matrices without revoxelising the bound details.
Collar interiors, adjustment holes, tag eyelets and harness loops remain open; independent triangle and aperture probes provide the geometric evidence beyond screenshots.
Cat/dog harnesses sit around the specified torso, collars around the specified neck and blank cattle tag hangs vertically. Back and front views show separate straps and retained original animals.

Polygonal wing borders, angular strap loops, projecting eyes and the retained source animals’ geometric coat patches remain stylised and require human art review. Some source coat patches show fine near-coplanar patterns in close views; no original animal geometry was changed in this batch.
visualReview.scope: Assistant visual inspection only. Finite author poses and specific static fits; no claim of human art acceptance, original runtime dimensions, biological motion or load certification.

sourceCorrections: Initial strap intersections, hind toes/leg roots and guide-frame gaps corrected in actual geometry; historical checks retained.
Bee reduced from roughly 8cm to 4cm full length, retaining 1mm native details. All other eleven default geometry hashes unchanged.

Initial export verifier encountered an unused global palette role without a mesh primitive. Harness now samples alpha only on actually used primitives and asserts the role is unused when skipping; exporter unchanged.
limitations: All technical candidates; human art acceptance zero.
Original species dimensions, animal controllers and source skeleton contracts unavailable.
Skeleton entries are author tooling guides; old animal skins have not been bound to these skeletons.
Each component has one rigid joint; no soft weights, gait/flight/swim clips, IK, retargeting or original runtime integration.
Finite static wearable studies only on CHAR306, CHAR307 and CHAR315. No load, escape-prevention or all-motion certification.
All visual meshes noncollision; separate skin triangle and aperture checks do not establish physical support.
Independent viewport fitting does not show comparative metre scale.
Software WebGL does not certify hardware frame rates.
